description:
Find pulse and legume genebank accessions by accession number or name (e.g. 'ICC 4958' for chickpea at
ICRISAT): chickpea, lentil, pea, faba bean, lupin, grass pea, Phaseolus, Vigna, pigeonpea, soybean, peanut and
Medicago accessions from GBIF, with the holding genebank (FAO WIEWS code, e.g. IND002 = ICRISAT, SYR002/LBN002 =
ICARDA) and accession number; mostly Svalbard safety duplicates. Passport data are minimal (no traits).
Also INRAE GnpIS pea and faba bean collections via FAIDARE, with taxon, holding institute, country of origin,
status, pedigree and panels.
name: find_germplasm
